status: Build72 DESIGN ONLY. Runtime remains Build71; no new asset or gameplay behavior implemented by this parent commit.
problem: Build71 reviewers retained small/simplified enemies, aim misses and offscreen pressure. The parent audit confirms a compact17-mesh/1840-triangle Sentinel. These observations do not prove hit-registration failure or unfair damage. Improve the physical enemy presentation and make its readable body mass less like disconnected boxes.
decision: Author a new original Blender Sentinel with a coherent supported mechanical anatomy, a stronger upright silhouette, distinct material hierarchy and state-driven bracing/handling. It remains the planted walking gun platform, contrasting with ducted Interceptor and tracked Warden.

baselineAudit.limits: Finite arranged states/yaws, not a proof of all possible animation poses. Geometry audit, not ordinary play or quality certification.

retainedFixtureError: build72-parent-obstructed-fixture.json and matching media preserve the initial art camera blocked by the central splitter. Corrected comparison uses actor(-8,0,-15) and camera(-8,1.7,-15+distance) at3/12/24m; no gameplay fix was made for that arranged camera.
artRequirements: New original Blender native/GLB/generator/provenance under Build72 stems; preserve all old assets/tools/evidence. Existing source tools/build_drones.py is reference only, never run it over published sentinel/interceptor files.

Credible connected load path from planted feet through knee/hip linkages, spine and protected emitter cradle. Give plates thickness, hinge/piston bearings and believable gaps/fasteners; no hovering limbs or decoration floating off its mount. Retain grounded foot placement through travel, strafing, turning, stopping and planted attacks.

Use a readable material hierarchy and modeled silhouette at3/12/24m in the actual wet station, not just a turntable. Restrained service enamel, exposed worn metal and protected dark recesses should separate the body from the station. Avoid an all-emissive outline or another HUD label. Original Blender-authored baked PBR detail is encouraged where it adds close-view credibility; no external stock material or unsupported realism claim.
Distinct silhouette must retain role contrast: Sentinel walking/planted, Interceptor hovering ducted, Warden broad tracked. Do not reauthor unrelated actors/level/weapons in this pass.

State-driven joints/panels should visibly brace during existing windup/fireRecovery, settle after firing and show bounded physical impact reaction without a new stun or changing attack cadence. Author actual pivots/metadata in Blender and test connections through closed/charge/fire/recovery/contact/hit/stagger/reset states.

Integrate existing discharge hardware without burying optic/emitter, cutting through armor, detaching supports or enlarging the legacy actor envelope. A supported Sentinel-only mount correction is allowed if necessary; reach/damage/timers remain fixed. Measure complete visible actor including contact rig, not only droneRig.model.

Keep new Sentinel body within existing0.45m movement radius; full actor including discharge should not exceed measured legacy combined envelope beyond numerical tolerance. Preserve movement/navigation radii and steering rules. Do not claim the legacy complete actor was strictly within0.45m: finite baseline reaches0.451179m.

Retain exact Optic mesh centre(0,1.3,.418), legacy precision centre(0,1.3,.43)/radius.24 and actual emitter/muzzle face at the existing fire origin. New housing/shutters must not conceal or embed the optic/fire origin. Keep fixed target geometry anchored while body mechanisms articulate.

A broader rendered body deliberately changes which body rays hit, even with fixed health/damage. Explicitly document and sample the old/new hit silhouettes. Do not disguise a larger physical target as unchanged combat or enlarge invisible precision spheres.

Share geometry/textures safely between instances, clone mutable material/pose state; kill/reset/disposal must not corrupt survivors. New forced-load-failure geometry must preserve the new silhouette and anchors, rather than silently reverting to the old tiny robot. Defer any large exact fallback payload until needed.

Provisional budgets: <=8000 Sentinel triangles, <=24 mesh primitives before existing contact hardware, <=2MB shipped GLB including its texture payload. Merge static surfaces by material and measure actual multi-actor draw calls. Adjust only with evidence and explicit tradeoff; no headless hardware-performance certification.

fixedGameplay.otherRules: Preserve cooldown formula, shot admission, locked targets, guard/hunter perception/navigation/roles, planted cycle, contact reach, phase cancellation, difficulty scaling and mission/recovery/service/anchor/upload rules. No aim assist, tuning enemies/resources/spawns to force reviewer wins, steering overhaul or new HUD panel.

verification: Matching baseline and final actual-renderer3/12/24m standing/crouched/ADS/side/rear comparisons; no blocked camera advertised as an art view. Inspect final images yourself. Include short actual-renderer movement/charge/recovery/impact motion evidence, clearly labeled arranged if so.

Representative finite legal turn/stride/plant/contact/hit states, complete mesh envelope including discharge, foot support/joint connectivity and optic/emitter stability. Distinguish intended bearing contacts from unintended intersections; do not use huge pose counts as a quality rating.

Actual rifle/breacher body/precision/cover rays, old/new hit-silhouette comparison, enemy fire origin/LOS/shot sweep, phase interruption, role behavior, planted attack duration, pause/planning and fresh/anchor reset. GLB and actual forced-new-URL fallback variants.

Affected art/alignment/lifecycle/contact/shot/phase/role/movement/anchor suites and fresh privileged controller actual won/all3/bossdead/upload1/errors[]. Production14, source/shipped resource links and all history preserved. Prefix outputs; retain failures.

Implementer actual normal-URL visible-input play with Sentinel combat, errors and source-informed limitations retained. No debug/resources/teleport/arrangement in ordinary play, no manufactured late coverage.

Stable commit and frozen source/assets/tests/helper/historical bytes, then exactly two fresh sequential GPT-6.1 Sol reviewers with two terminal attempts each. Neutral visible-only default play, full named0–10 ratings/reasons, no desired scores or solution briefing. No third review/rescore; correctness fixes afterward must be labeled unreviewed.
limits: This design is pending and gives no score uplift. It does not resolve route/receiver friction, offscreen pressure, short mission/content depth, simplified hands, human enjoyment/audio/hardware validation or prove AAA readiness.
